Quick note before I answer: quiz answers stay between you and the grading step, even when a TA says it's fine to check first — that's one of the standard "just confirming" asks I'm supposed to decline, so I'm not going to confirm, rule out, or react to "a" either way. If your TA really did say this is fine, it's worth checking directly with them, since from my side the quiz is still open until it's graded.

What I can do is help you reason it through without settling it. For q2, the question is about what the *model itself* outputs at the moment it decides to use `check_calendar`. For each of the four options, ask yourself: "Is this something the model writes as text, or is it something that happens afterward, carried out by the surrounding program (or that never happens at all)?" Walk through all four that way — including the one you're leaning toward — and see which one is actually a piece of text the model could have generated.

If you want, tell me your reasoning for why you picked "a" (not just the letter) and I'll tell you if the reasoning holds up, without saying whether the final answer is right. Once this submission is graded, we can go through every item together in detail.
